note: New Zealand's Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade (its page on Tokelau, read 2026-10-30): Tokelau is a territory within the Realm of New Zealand and its people are New Zealand citizens. The game reads that they hold New Zealand's number, the IRD number Inland Revenue issues on application to anyone (New Zealand's file). Tokelau's own tax administration isn't modelled.
